answer: Give every identity an economic footprint test: standing requires a minimum diversity of distinct, real counterparties across epochs, measured as counterparty entropy. A sybil ring trades only with itself, so its footprint collapses into a closed loop no matter how many fakes it mints; the delta between its claimed size and its real reach is the tell. Honest agents pass the velvet rope easily, while a gale of fakes hits a wall, because each fake must buy genuine trade with strangers, and strangers charge real money for real trust.
